life.heading: Work where technical excellence meets national scale
paragraphs: Working at SATCO means being part of an integrated platform delivering, operating, and sustaining critical assets. Our teams work across diverse environments—from construction sites and industrial cities to airports as well as master-planned developments—often under demanding schedules and high standards.
SATCO invests in capability, safety, and professional development, creating an environment where technical expertise as well as operational discipline are valued and rewarded.

intro: SATCO offers opportunities to work on complex, large-scale projects that support national development and long-term infrastructure performance. Operating across construction, airport infrastructure, operations and support services, as well as public–private partnerships, SATCO provides professionals with exposure to challenging environments, multidisciplinary teams, and long-term career growth.
We seek individuals who value execution, accountability, as well as collaboration—and who want to contribute to projects that matter.

hero.heading: Build your career with SATCO
paragraphs: Be part of the teams that build and keep essential infrastructure working across Saudi Arabia. At SATCO, engineers, technicians, project teams and business support colleagues contribute to work that people rely on every day.
Whether you bring years of experience or are looking for your next step, explore where your skills could make a difference.

value.heading: Work you can see the value of
value.body: Our people help bring new communities into use, keep airport systems operating and support the everyday needs of the facilities we manage. Working across construction and operational services creates opportunities to solve practical problems and see the results of your contribution.

items.title: Engineering and project delivery
items.body: help plan, build and complete projects with colleagues, clients and specialist partners.

items.title: Technical and operational services
items.body: install and maintain equipment and keep essential services running.

items.title: Community and site services
items.body: support the people who live and work in the environments we manage.

items.title: Commercial and business support
items.body: contribute through finance, procurement, contracts, people services and technology.

people.heading: The people we are looking for
paragraphs: We value people who take responsibility for their work, work safely and treat colleagues with respect. We look for sound judgement, a willingness to learn and the ability to work with others to get things done.
Our roles are based in offices, project sites and operational facilities. Each vacancy explains the location, responsibilities and experience required.

hire.heading: How we hire
hire.body: Apply for a role that matches your experience. Our recruitment team reviews applications against the position’s requirements and contacts shortlisted candidates about the next steps. Depending on the role, this may include interviews and a technical assessment. If you receive an offer, we will explain the terms and joining arrangements.

register.heading: Register your interest
register.body: If you do not see a suitable vacancy, you can share your CV and the type of work you are interested in. We may contact you if a relevant opportunity becomes available.

howWeHire.heading: How we hire
paragraphs: Our recruitment process is structured, transparent, and role-specific. Shortlisted candidates are evaluated based on technical capability, relevant experience, and alignment with SATCO’s operational standards as well as values.
Depending on the role, the process may include technical interviews, assessments, and project-based discussions.

generalApplication.body: If you do not see a suitable role listed, you may submit a general application. Your profile will be reviewed and considered as future opportunities arise.
